references.title: Controlled Traffic Flood Indicators
references.objective: Identify a bounded rise in flow rate and destination concentration without claiming service denial.
references.false_positive: Approved load and performance tests can produce the same observations.
references.blind_spot: Sampled flow export may understate packet rate and cannot prove availability impact.

references.title: DNS Diversity and NXDOMAIN Indicators
references.objective: Identify a modeled rise in DNS query diversity and NXDOMAIN responses.
references.false_positive: Software discovery, search suffixes, and mistyped names can create NXDOMAIN bursts.
references.blind_spot: Entropy and NXDOMAIN volume alone do not prove malware or a DGA.

references.title: Periodic External Communication Indicators
references.objective: Identify repeated destination contact with controlled jitter and DNS association.
references.false_positive: Monitoring agents and update services often use periodic heartbeats.
references.blind_spot: Encrypted flow timing does not reveal command content.

references.title: Internal Reconnaissance Indicators
references.objective: Identify a bounded rise in internal destination and port diversity.
references.false_positive: Approved vulnerability scanners and inventory tools can produce similar flows.
references.blind_spot: Connection attempts do not prove successful lateral movement.

references.title: DNS Tunneling and Exfiltration Indicators
references.objective: Identify synthetic long-subdomain and DNS-flow indicators without performing or claiming exfiltration.
references.false_positive: CDNs, tracking identifiers, and service discovery can use long diverse labels.
references.blind_spot: The lab carries benign synthetic labels and cannot confirm exfiltration.

references.title: Cross-Source DNS, Beaconing, and Reconnaissance Incident
references.objective: Correlate DNS, periodic external communication, and internal reconnaissance indicators from one deterministic incident.
references.false_positive: Monitoring followed by approved scanning can resemble the sequence.
references.blind_spot: No endpoint execution, identity evidence, attribution, or compromise confirmation is modeled.
